coverage_notes.observation: No new same-window U.S. incident independently verified by fresh local or official sources. All twelve targeted searches returned usable results, but mostly old incidents, prior reports and unrelated material. The October 31 Provo, Utah Community Action Services and Food Bank closure is a known candidate, not a new signal.

excluded_examples.reason: Previously identified Provo, Utah Community Action Services and Food Bank closure candidate; duplicate, not a new report in this hour.

excluded_examples.title: Oct. 29 Hurricane Lowell recovery, County of Kauaʻi services update
excluded_examples.reason: Older official bulletin confirms a planned October 30 emergency distribution, not a new cancellation.

excluded_examples.title: Kauaʻi flood warning: Hanalei refuge offers shelter but not food, water or medical care
excluded_examples.reason: Refuge facility does not offer food as standard service; no cancellation or reduction of an existing food distribution verified.

duplicate_screen.method: Read prior committed heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger and compared returned incident/source dates and previously surfaced Provo candidate.

coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded web recall is non-exhaustive, and same-hour local agency notices may be unavailable or not yet indexed. No findings does not prove absence of incidents.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No content approval, production publishing, production collection changes, schedule change, or task disabling.
